title: Bank of New York Mellon Corp 8-K Filing — 2026-04-23
summary: The Bank of New York Mellon Corporation filed a Form 8-K on April 23, 2026, disclosing the issuance of $1.5 billion in aggregate principal amount of senior medium-term notes across two series: $750 million of 4.540% Fixed/Floating Rate Notes due 2032 and $750 million of 5.085% Fixed/Floating Rate Notes due 2037. This is a routine corporate securities filing and does not relate to market structure or macro catalysts.
key_points: BNY Mellon issued $750 million of 4.540% Fixed/Floating Rate Callable Senior Medium-Term Notes Series J due 2032
BNY Mellon issued $750 million of 5.085% Fixed/Floating Rate Callable Senior Medium-Term Notes Series J due 2037
Notes were registered under Securities Act of 1933 via Form S-3 registration statement
Filing includes legal opinions from Sullivan & Cromwell LLP
Company common stock trades as BK on NYSE, preferred securities also listed
